english.title: Owner of unlicensed hackney carriage found on stand within the Metropolitan Police District or City of London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the owner of an unlicensed hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY CARRIAGE AND INDEX NUMBER WHERE APPLICABLE..), which was found on a stand within the limits of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869 at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7 of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the owner or driver of an unlicensed hackney carriage
which was found on a stand within the metropolitan police district or the City of London

english.notes: The driver shall be liable unless he proves that he was ignorant of the fact of the carriage being an unlicensed carriage
